{{Quote|It's unfortunate that Romo Vax was a spy. My understanding is that it's a name the Sennex pirates have used for many years, with many different agents. We should be more careful in the future.|[[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JPBF" />}}
'''Romo Vax''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a member of the [[Sennex]] pirates on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|He is working for the Sennex pirates. Despite your interference with my spies in Wayfar, I've been able to verify Romo's association with the Sennex. To make amends to me for killing my spies, you shall go take care of Romo Vax. I want him eliminated.|Bib Fortuna, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JPBF" />}}
Romo Vax was a member of the Sennex,<ref name="SWG:JPBF" /> a group of despicable [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]],<ref name="CDHZ">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80113|text=CorSec Database H-Z|int=CorSec Database H-Z}}</ref> hostile to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]].<ref name="SWG:JPBF" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Romo Vax succeeded in infiltrating [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:JPBF" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Romo Vax was pursued by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Hizram Riean]]. Jabba's [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] quickly dispatched a spacer to kill the bounty hunter before he could reach [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]].<ref name="SWG:BF">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Bib Fortuna|Tatooine}}</ref>

At some point, Fortuna suspected Romo Vax to double cross Jabba's organization so he hired the [[Wayfar spies]] to watch for Vax. However, the Sennex eventually figured out that he was watched.<ref name="SWG:JPBF" /> In 1 ABY,<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Bib Fortuna sent a spacer to retrieve information from Romo Vax for Jabba. In order to get rid of the Wayfar spies, Romo Vax convinced the spacer that the Wayfar spies were enemies of Jabba, when in reality they worked for Fortuna. The deceived spacer therefore killed several Wayfar spies in the desert, including their leader [[Dewall Paez]]. Vax later claimed that the information Bib Fortuna was looking for was stolen by [[Valarian Syndicate|Valarian]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] who also wiped the data from his [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. The spacer then attacked [[Valarian hackers' bunker]] and retrieve the stolen data. In the end, Bib Fortuna discovered that Vax had made kill his spies and was also responsible for giving the information to the Valarians. The majordomo therefore ordered the spacer to assassinate the traitor. Romo Vax was ultimately killed by the spacer, along with his Sennex henchmen, in his [[Romo Vax's Hideout|secret hideout]] near Jabba's Palace.<ref name="SWG:JPBF" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateNoble.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Romo Vax prior to the 2005 overhaul]]
Romo Vax was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JPBF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Romo Vax was present in the original release of the game, being part of the first version of the [[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Jabba's Theme Park]]. Because Vax spawned under the generic "noble" template, his appearance was randomized under one of forty-two possible depictions and would fluctuate after each server reset.<ref name="SWG:BF" />

With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> the Jabba's Theme Park was extensively [[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park|revamped]]. In addition to major changes in the storyline, Romo Vax was given an unique appearance.<ref name="SWG:JPBF" />
